exposure: Vaginal pH screening for Bacterial Vaginosis (BV)
Treatment for asymptomatic Bacterial Vaginosis with metronidazole
outcome: Sensitivity and specificity of vaginal pH for BV
cohort: The study included 440 pregnant women between 16-18 weeks of gestation without vaginal discharge, randomly assigned to a screening/treatment group or a control group.
finding: Treating asymptomatic Bacterial Vaginosis in early second trimester significantly decreases preterm births, PPROM, and neonatal respiratory complications.
birth_weight: Not specified but measured, with no significant difference found between groups.
gest_age: Enrollment at 16-18 weeks of gestation; preterm delivery was an outcome.
